page.overview:
Who is Breviceratops?

(meaning "short horned face") is a genus of ceratopsian dinosaur closely related to Protoceratops that lived in Mongolia during the Late Cretaceous period. Like its relative, it would have browsed the dry Cretaceous land for low-growing plants. It is another example of the development of the ceratopsian family in Asia.

Originally assigned to Protoceratops, there is still discussion as to whether this specimen deserves its own genus. It may eventually be reassigned to Bagaceratops. However, this may not be happening as Bagaceratops lived during the Maastrichtian while Breviceratops comes from the Campanian.

Breviceratops was featured in the Jurassic Park Institute now available to browse on Dinopedia.
